prioritizedActionRoadmap.title: Implement Lazy Loading & Stream Compression for Hero Videos
prioritizedActionRoadmap.description: Film video (film/1.mp4, 3.9 MB) represents 60% of initial page weight. Convert to HLS / multi-bitrate streams and delay autoplay until user interaction or viewport intersection to dramatically improve Mobile LCP and reduce Mobile TBT.

prioritizedActionRoadmap.title: Upgrade DMARC Policy to Quarantine & Submit HSTS Preload
prioritizedActionRoadmap.description: Update _dmarc.7z-magic.com from 'p=none' to 'p=quarantine; pct=100' after verifying Zoho Mail deliverability. Submit domain to hstspreload.org to hardcode HTTPS into browser binaries.

prioritizedActionRoadmap.title: Transition Inline Scripts to Cryptographic Nonces
prioritizedActionRoadmap.description: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from script-src in CSP by generating random nonces for inline analytics and Three.js bootstrap scripts, neutralizing XSS injection risks.

prioritizedActionRoadmap.title: Adjust Text Contrast on About Discipline Numbers & Remove aria-current on Services Articles
prioritizedActionRoadmap.description: Increase contrast ratio of .about-discipline__number from 3.2:1 to >= 4.5:1. Replace aria-current='true' on article tags with class-based active indicators or apply to appropriate navigation links.

prioritizedActionRoadmap.title: Remove Redundant role='region' on Section Elements
prioritizedActionRoadmap.description: Eliminate explicit role='region' on <section aria-label='...'> elements to clear the 3 W3C validator warnings.
